what: When you hover a card the photo frame recedes to .97 while the photo inside moves from 1.04 to 1.07 (.4s ease, optionally the photo darkens) — the frame shrinks while the photo grows, a crossing motion. The round arrow at the photo corner swells 1.6× pivoting on the bottom left, growing toward the top right.

options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo approaching within the frame — can be several (each slide of the photo-flip panel)
options.[data-fx-part=badge]: (if present) corner marker — grows on hover, and also grows on focus
options.--fx-rest·--fx-zoom: Photo resting scale · hover scale (via style), default 1.04·1.07
options.--fx-badge·--fx-badge-origin: Display scale and axis (via style), default 1.6·bottom left
options.--fx-dur·--fx-ease: Duration and curve (set via style), default .4s · ease
options.--fx-dim: Photo brightness when raised (via style), default 1 (unchanged) — Brand .8

use: →
note: Scale is applied with the scale property so it does not clash with the user’s transform (such as translate on a slide panel). The badge must sit as a sibling outside the frame so it does not shrink with the frame.

from.where: index.html .eb-loc (stay card — original style.css .location-card:hover .loc-carousel__wrap scale .97 · .loc-carousel__slide img 1.04→1.07 · .loc-carousel__cta-pc 1.6 (transform-origin bottom left), all .4s ease, desktop widths only)
